research_claim: Project binary task controlled ablation, not exact author reproduction
primary_architecture_reference: Existing dense ReconstructionConfig; no model source modifications this round
selection_basis: Keep the existing explicitly documented figure-based candidate; not chosen by test or best validation accuracy

proposed_common_settings.initialization: fresh paired ImageNet V1 backbone, paired task head; new module initialization per arm
proposed_common_settings.input: full-video uniform endpoints; full-frame INTER_AREA RGB; fixed ImageNet normalization
proposed_common_settings.BN: all BatchNorm affine and buffers frozen, including new TSCI; project choice, not verified paper recipe
proposed_common_settings.selection: lowest complete validation CE; ties earlier epoch
proposed_common_settings.evaluation: same frozen-BN rule for all arms; do not import TANet per-video L policy

before_any_launch: Implement or review one common four-arm trainer and paired initialization; existing candidate/DW3D trainers are not a drop-in lsta-only trainer.
Verify loss normalization, tail batch, checkpoint/resume, trainable scope and same validation rule for every arm.
Run bounded GPU readiness including all arms and measured resource usage; do not reuse past readiness for a new trainer.
DW3D_role: separate efficiency hypothesis; not the author default
proposal_role: audit-only mirror; do not silently replace the selected candidate
SpaceJam: deferred independent ten-class study; no download or training authorized in this round
test: No new test. The project already has prior test exposure; no globally untouched holdout claim.
